item.title: BROWN: My friend Carrie
item.description: It was a common occurrence on any random afternoon for me to drop by my sister/friend Carrie Cox’s house for a snack: a Diet Coke and chips or cheese and crackers, with the intention of watching an interesting television show. For months, we watched “The Crown,” but sadly, we never completed the series.
